waves.name: Claims and proof authority
waves.goal: Define the finite product contract and make later green verdicts exact-build and candidate-bound.
conditions: A finite, source-current advertised-claims ledger covers every material release promise and maps it to current product authority or an explicit gap.
Build receipts classify official, reproducible-source, custom, and dirty-dev artifacts without treating open-source builders or the machine owner as adversaries.

Installed proof accepts only a packaged Tauri desktop surface whose executable-derived source and artifact identity matches the explicit candidate; browser, dirty, stale, and mismatched evidence fails closed.
The product-perfect verdict remains separate from READY, signing, publishing, deployment, and release authority.

waves.name: Installed first-user journey
waves.goal: Prove that a new user can reach one real useful result in the clean installed app without getting stranded or seeing false health.
conditions: On one clean installed candidate, a new user connects a real provider, creates an Overseer, completes one real task, and opens its deliverable in under ten minutes.
The journey walks visible failure and recovery states rather than checking only that controls exist.
Beginner Run no longer stops at STUCK@title and records the exact installed candidate.
A healthy idle transport never renders LINK DOWN, while an actually disconnected transport still does.

waves.name: Verdict-filtered security and authority
waves.goal: Close only the security, privacy, and capability escapes the W0 verdict proved open.
conditions: Child environments, browser and web egress, recursive filesystem access, channel pairing, scoped Workshop reads, delegation consent, secret custody, and boot egress pass their W0-identified negative tests.
Slack and Matrix token persistence uses the desktop keychain with read-back before deleting any prior copy; Signal is not assigned a token requirement it does not have.
Every run mode uses persisted effective station authority or fails closed to its proven subset; no execution-mode shortcut silently grants full office capability.
Known shipped contracts remain intact, including durable E-STOP, consent visibility, leash pre-spend, truthful /api/version, and HTTP 200 degraded-workspace refusal.

waves.name: Last-mile UI and recovery
waves.goal: Unify existing work and recovery machinery into reachable, truthful user surfaces.
conditions: One visible work-and-deliverables ledger and a cold-boot recap read from the existing authoritative stores.
Settings exposes the existing full-agent export and post-onboarding base-URL editor without creating parallel storage.
Export, backup, restore, OPEN, undo, OAuth cancellation, and destructive-action recovery complete end to end with truthful feedback.
Every user-facing failure has a specific next action and no control ends in a silent or permanent busy state.
The attended visual pass finds no clipped, overlapping, inaccessible, placeholder, or inconsistent release-facing UI.

waves.name: Capability enforcement decisions
waves.goal: Make the run-mode by capability contract explicit before changing the locked object-equals-capability promise.
conditions: Direct, scheduled, channel, Night Shift, and delegated runs each have a code-evidenced ENFORCED or NOT ENFORCED capability row.
Any proposed narrowing of object-equals-capability is recorded as an owner decision and stops implementation until Andrew decides it.
Approved enforcement fixes are covered across removal, restoration, interruption, and restart.
Every status and capability label reads from the owning backend authority rather than decorative or account-presence state.

waves.name: Autonomy and lifecycle honesty
waves.goal: Unify adaptation without inventing background hosting or another user-understanding silo.
conditions: All while-closed copy says while StarNet is running unless background hosting is independently proven on that platform.
Night Shift, routines, and interactive work use one server-owned Commander context composer rather than parallel understanding stores.
Keep and decline reasons extend the unified composer, and declined ideas remain suppressed across restart.
Learning claims are measurable, inspectable, interruptible, budget-bounded, and permission-gated.

waves.name: Integration and full behavioral proof
waves.goal: Prove every advertised integration, UI surface, and backend promise against the same installed candidate.
conditions: Each advertised provider, channel, MCP connector, OAuth flow, and remote service has attended connect, success, failure, restart, revoke, and secret-removal proof or a visible experimental label.
The claims ledger is terminal on this candidate: every advertised promise is proven or visibly experimental at its point of use.
The Station Atlas is fresh on the candidate and reports perfected-fresh equal to total, with zero unmapped, mapped-only, audited-only, stale, or missing entries.
Backend-only tools, persistence boundaries, desktop commands, integrations, and lifecycle promises not represented by the Atlas have explicit machine/live proof.
Fast, HTTP/E2E, journey, recovery, restart, long-lived, visual, and installed-desktop suites all pass on the same candidate.
The product-facing ledger has zero open P0, P1, or P2 findings; accepted limitations are explicit non-product release exclusions, not hidden debt.

waves.name: Frozen product-validation candidate
waves.goal: Validate one immutable desktop candidate long enough to justify the PRODUCT PERFECT verdict.
conditions: Every receipt names the same clean source commit, app version, packaged artifact SHA-256 values, and wave-definition hash.

The frozen candidate completes at least 48 continuous hours of representative real-provider dogfood, including the first real Night Shift overnight, with no P0/P1, truth escape, data-loss event, wedged run, or unexplained sidecar death.
Five attended beginner sessions, ten clean-machine installs, and a current eyes-on visual review pass on the unchanged artifact.
READY, installed desktop, full Atlas, security, recovery, integration, and behavioral gates are rerun after the soak without rebuilding the artifact.
The terminal output is PRODUCT PERFECT; it does not authorize publishing, signing, deployment, credential rotation, or public release.
